questionText:
Arrange the following events in the correct chronological order.
 
(A) Gorbachev resigns as the president of the Soviet Union.
(B) The Soviet Union declares that the Warsaw Pact members are free to
decide their own futures.
(C) The independence movement began in Lithuania, Estonia and Latvia.
(D) The Russian Parliament declares its independence from the Soviet
Union.
 
Choose the correct sequence from the options given below.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chronological progression: (C) Popular front independence movements in Lithuania, Estonia, and Latvia gathered strength in 1988; (B) In 1989, the USSR declared Warsaw Pact states free to chart their own course, precipitating the fall of Communist regimes; (D) In June 1990, the Russian Parliament declared state sovereignty/independence; (A) On 25 December 1991, Gorbachev resigned as President of the USSR. Sequence: (C), (B), (D), (A).
Hence, option (A) is correct.
